notes.title: Episode 2 Update for Demo Alpha v0.0.200: New Level and Enhancements!
New Update: Trading Cards and Community Items Now Available!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that our game now features trading cards, badges, profile backgrounds, and emoticons! Collect cards to craft badges, level up your Steam profile, and unlock unique community items.

Now you have the opportunity to dive even deeper into the game world and show your support by collecting and trading these exclusive items.

Don't miss out—start collecting them now! ːro2_robotː

notes.title: Update! Long-awaited Achievements Are Now in the Game!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

In the latest game update, we’ve added a variety of improvements, but the main event is the long-awaited achievements! We know you've been waiting for this moment, and we’ve finally made it happen. There are 10 achievements available, and we hope you enjoy unlocking them!

For developers using Godot Engine who are still figuring out how to add achievements and are looking for a solution, we have good news: you can use the GodotSteam addon. It works with both versions 3 and 4 and offers a lot of additional features. Thanks to the developers!

notes.title: New features and improvements in the latest game update!
notes.notes:
In the latest update, we've added new features to make the gameplay even more convenient and enjoyable. Now you can speed up your character's walking speed with a double click and automatically pause the game when the window is minimized. In version 1.0.292, we've addressed some issues with the pause feature, which now also includes a timer for the dialogue window and music.

In the game settings, we've made the following improvements:

[list]
[*] Increased the window size and improved its design for better readability and capacity.
[*] Added a separate volume control for the music compared to other sounds.
[*] Fixed a bug where sound would continue to play even at minimum volume.
[*] Added the ability to switch settings using the more convenient left and right arrows.
[/list]

Additionally, we've fixed many minor bugs, such as changing the position of the close button to the top right corner and design changes.

Enjoy playing and have a great day, friends!

notes.title: The demo version of Mechanic 8230: Mission Citytone is now available!
notes.notes:
Currently, there are four languages supported: Russian, English, German, and Japanese. A big thank you to Artem Belov (English) and Tausret (German) for their help with the translations! The Japanese localization is purely amateur and was created with the help of ChatGPT. If Japanese players have a desire to improve it, please let us know. This applies to any other languages as well. You can find more information about localization [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2508560/discussions/0/3807282258511501852/.]here[/url].

We plan to add another small level to the demo, which will be available in one of the upcoming updates.

There may be bugs in the game - well, how is without it? Please report any issues. We also welcome your impressions and any other feedback.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2508560/_8230/]Enjoy the game![/url]
